text:
Maria: Quick heads-up — planning a small micro-influence + webinar push next week to test an activation path that ties free credits -> prompt templates -> onboarding nudges. Goal: +10% DAU from seeded cohorts, move people from signup -> first 3 queries within 48h. Thoughts?

Ajay: love it. which cohort size are we thinking and who are the micro-influencers?

Maria: target 500 seeded signups (split A/B). we'll use 10 micro-influencers with developer audiences (Twitter/X + Discord). micro-influencers get 100 starter credits + 1:1 quick onboarding session.

Sasha: draft social post ideas and webinar copy ready. will surface 2 prompt template packs: "hackathon-starter" and "sales-cold-email". short posts: `Just tried @RedwoodInference — 100 free starter credits + template pack. Join our 30-min workshop tomorrow.`

Kevin: quick numbers — baseline conversion (signup -> first 3 queries) for similar promos was 18%. with credits + templates I model a lift to ~26%. for 500 signups, expect ~130 extra active users within 48h. CI wide but promising.

Ellie: routing note — for seeded signups we should bypass default product tour and instead route them to the microinfluence onboarding flow (prompt templates modal + CTA: "Run sample"), also enqueue a 24h activation nudge via email and in-app.

Maria: agreed on routing. A/B: A gets 100 credits + templates + webinar invite; B gets 100 credits + templates but no webinar (just nudge). want to isolate webinar effect.

Sasha: copy for webinar invite (short): "Build with Redwood: 30-min hands-on prompt workshop + free credits". social CTA: "Sign up, claim credits, bring a prompt — we’ll optimize it live."

Ajay: tagging growth ops — can we surface a UTM per influencer and add a hidden cohort flag so product can detect seeded users?

Kevin: yes — easiest is ?utm_source=influencerX and set metadata `seed_cohort: microX` in signup flow. I can wire analytics to flag them and report activation funnel by cohort.

Ellie: onboarding nudge cadence proposal: 0h in-app welcome (+templates modal), 24h email nudge with 3 sample prompts, 48h in-app push if no activity. Also include an optional 1:1 office hours slot in the webinar for cohort A.

Maria: budget question — credits cost forecast?

Kevin: credits = 500 signups * 100 credits = 50k starter credits. expected token consumption per user ~200 tokens/day first 2 days. cost estimate ~low hundreds USD overall for the test.

Sasha: prompt templates (examples) — will add as code block in marketing repo:
```
// hackathon-starter pack
1) "Build a prototype that extracts meeting notes from audio. Show me sample prompt chain."
2) "Given this user story, generate a minimal working prompt and test cases."

// sales-cold-email
1) "Rewrite this cold email for VP of Sales, reduce length to 4 lines, add specific pain point."
```

Ajay: timeline? when does influencer posting + webinar happen?

Maria: influencer posts go live Tue 10AM PT, webinar Wed 4PM PT, routing + credits live at Tue 9AM PT to catch early signups. need social assets + landing + signup gating by Mon EOD.

Ellie: for gating — we'll show credits claim after email verify to reduce spam. signup flow: email -> verify -> claim credits (auto-add to account). product can set `onboarding_variant: A|B`.

Kevin: I'll set up cohort dashboards: activation funnel, LTV proxies (avg queries/day), and retention at 7d. will share a quick Looker link once ready.

Sasha: I'll push social copy + hero image to the drive and drop link here by EOD.

Maria: action items: Sasha social + templates, Kevin analytics + cost estimate, Ellie routing + gating, Ajay influencer coord, deploy-bot schedule webinar and calendar. check-ins tomorrow 10AM PT. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Created calendar event "Micro-influencer activation workshop" Wed 16:00 PT — invite sent to #marketing.

Ajay: noted. also recommend a small leaderboard or tweet highlight for influencers to encourage follow-ups.

Sasha: good idea — will add a short referral card they can share with followers.

Maria: nice. final Q: do we want to experiment with credit amount? maybe split group A1 100 credits vs A2 200 credits for 150 users each?

Kevin: statistically might be underpowered at n=150 per variant but we can still observe directionality. if we really care about lift vs cost, better to keep control group with 100 and a smaller 200 test (n=75) for signal.

Ellie: ops note — keep rollback plan: if we see spammy signups, pause credit issuance and require manual whitelist for influencers.

Maria: perfect. thanks team — please update the checklist in the launch doc and I’ll round up the influencer list.

Sasha: checklist link dropped: https://drive.google.com/marketing/micro-influence-launch (mock link)

Kevin: analytics dashboard will be here by noon tomorrow (placeholder): https://app.redwood/analytics/micro-seed (mock link)

Maria: thanks — see you tomorrow 10AM PT. :v:
